```{=html}
<script>
function filterByTopic(topic) {
  // Update active pill UI
  document.querySelectorAll('.topic-pill').forEach(btn => {
    if (btn.getAttribute('data-topic') === topic) {
      btn.classList.add('active');
    } else {
      btn.classList.remove('active');
    }
  });

  // Trigger Quarto Listing Category filtering
  if (topic === '') {
    if (typeof window.quartoListingCategory === 'function') {
      window.quartoListingCategory('');
    }
  } else {
    if (typeof window.quartoListingCategory === 'function') {
      const b64 = btoa(encodeURIComponent(topic));
      window.quartoListingCategory(b64);
    }
  }
}

// Ensure active state matches on load
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const hash = window.location.hash;
  if (hash && hash.includes('category=')) {
    const raw = decodeURIComponent(hash.split('category=')[1] || '');
    document.querySelectorAll('.topic-pill').forEach(btn => {
      if (btn.getAttribute('data-topic') === raw) {
        btn.classList.add('active');
      } else {
        btn.classList.remove('active');
      }
    });
  }
});
</script>
```
